lines.label: B1
lines.reason: 90 deg fold, base 1 into a+ long wall 3. In zoomed perpendicular sections (slab ±4 mm) at 25/50/75% the label sits on the outer arc apex: the highest outer-skin point is 0.06/0.11/0.29 mm outward of the line. The outer skin is noisier near the b+ end, but the line stays inside the noise band. The flange-presence profile shows both flanges from t=-1 to 267 mm against a label span of 0 to 267.6 mm, so it covers the full wall length and is parallel.

lines.label: B2
lines.reason: 90 deg fold, base into a- tab 5/6. Apex offset 0.01-0.03 mm at 25/50/75%. Both flanges are present from t=-1 to 107 against a label span of 0 to 107.8, so it covers the full tab width. It is kept as a separate bend from B3 because the two tabs are separate plates with about 90 mm of bare plate edge between them, which follows the gold v1 separate-tab precedent (sc_3c93a0bf6f97, sc_cebb070285b5).

lines.label: B5
lines.reason: First bend of the joggle: upper wall 7 turns inward into the step at about 9 mm (shown in the wide sections at ax2 = -80/0/80). Apex offset is 0.01 mm at all three stations. Both flanges are present from t=-1 to 203 against a label span of 0 to 202.7.

lines.label: B6
lines.reason: Second bend of the joggle: the step turns down into lower wall 10/11. It is real and 90 deg (wide sections). The convex outer skin on the step-top side is only sparsely scanned. The scanned inner-arc apex is 1.35 mm below the line at all stations, and the skin separation measured at B2-B5 is 1.7-1.9 mm, so the outer apex should lie 0.35-0.55 mm outward of the line. The sparse outer-skin points agree (top-5 mean 0.78/0.48/0.28 mm at 25/50/75%). The line is parallel and under the 1 mm limit, so it is OK, but not exactly on the apex. Both flanges are present from t=-1 to 189 against a label span of 0 to 189.6.
